title: Install Caddy and write the Caddyfile inside LXC 120
runbook:
## Prerequisites

- Container 120 (`caddy-proxy`) exists on this host
- Caddy package is installed inside container 120

## Run this

```bash
pct start 120
```

```bash
pct exec 120 -- apt-get update
```

```bash
pct exec 120 -- apt-get install -y caddy
```

```bash
pct exec 120 -- tee /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
```

## Verify

- Caddy is installed: `pct exec 120 -- caddy version`
- Caddyfile exists with expected size: `pct exec 120 -- wc -c /etc/caddy/Caddyfile`
- Config is valid: `pct exec 120 -- caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile`
- Caddy service is active: `pct exec 120 -- systemctl is-active caddy`

## Rollback

- If validation fails, inspect the file: `pct exec 120 -- cat /etc/caddy/Caddyfile`
- To remove the bad config: `pct exec 120 -- rm /etc/caddy/Caddyfile`
- To stop Caddy: `pct exec 120 -- systemctl stop caddy`

refused.why: container 120 is stopped, so `pct exec` fails before it starts. Start it first (`pct start 120`).
